verdict.rationale: Granola Chat explicitly supports asking natural-language questions across meeting notes ('recall meeting details, spot patterns across customer calls') and MCP/API let you 'search through your meeting notes, find specific topics discussed in past meetings' across your whole history. However, evidence of source-citation is thin — the only sourcing feature documented (the magnifying-glass 'see where in the transcript or raw notes the note came from') applies to individual note generation, not to Chat's cross-meeting answers, and no docs confirm Chat answers link back to which meetings/sources it drew from. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that Chat answers include per-meeting source citations, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the search quality across large meeting histories.
